text:
nicole: Heads-up: opened PR to tidy a few console/observability docs things that tripped up a customer debug session today. PR: https://github.com/redwood-inference/docs/pull/2460

ben: link? what broke in the wild?
nicole: quick list:
- heatmap legend uses `p50/p99` labels inconsistently vs the dashboard UI (saw p95 in one sample)
- tracehook example shows `Trace-Id` header while runtime expects `x-rd-trace` (case-sensitivity confusion)
- our Ruby snippet uses `response[:cost_tokens]` which is out of date; modern SDKs expose `usage["tokens"]`
- example YAML for dashboard presets included a stale `sampling: auto` field that doesn't map to current sampling config

aru: ouch. those legend differences cause users to misread latency buckets. can you standardize to the dashboard naming and add a tiny note about metric percentiles?
nicole: done — unified labels to "p50, p95, p99" across examples and added a 1-line callout: "Percentiles in the UI map to the same labels used below; ensure you select the same aggregation when comparing."
fionna: for the trace header mismatch, can we add a short snippet showing nginx/ingress forwarding? people often copy that verbatim.
nicole: added a minimal nginx proxy snippet showing: `proxy_set_header x-rd-trace $http_x_trace_id;` and a note about header name normalization. kept it short to avoid platform-specific overload.

ben: ruby->usage change makes sense. also, we should add a compatibility footnote for Dedicated customers who pin older runtimes (SDKs <2.4) since field names changed.
nicole: added compatibility note with link to the migration guide under /sdk/migration/telemetry-2-4. docs-bot, run linkcheck?
docs-bot: linkcheck: build flagged 1 broken internal link in docs/console/observability/heatmap.md line 84 -> /sdk/telemetry/old (404). Suggested replacement: /sdk/migration/telemetry-2-4.

aru: i'll open a tiny site-redir after merge to 301 the old path. also can we add a changelog line? the heatmap legend change is user-visible and might confuse customers comparing saved views.
nicole: added a short "Docs changelog" entry under the observability section summarizing the legend rename and sampling YAML cleanup.

fionna: minor wording nit in the nginx code comment; left an inline suggestion. otherwise LGTM.

ben: one more ask: for the dashboard preset YAML, include a brief note about "namespaced metric keys" (kv-prefixed keys) so platform teams don't accidentally overwrite system metrics when importing.
nicole: added that 1-line caution and moved the example into a separate boxed note so it doesn't look like a drop-in.

aru: site-config redirect PR: https://github.com/redwood-inference/site-config/pull/301 created, 301 from /sdk/telemetry/old -> /sdk/migration/telemetry-2-4. will ping infra for quick review.
docs-bot: CI: docs build succeeded locally but linkcheck still failing until site-config redirect is merged. once site-config lands, the linkcheck should pass on main.

fionna: sounds good. nicole, can you squash the tiny fixups and i'll merge after standup if CI goes green? :white_check_mark:

nicole: squashed and pushed. merging after the redirect PR gets an approval. thanks all :rocket:
